links.outcome: Correctness and completeness of ChatGPT differential diagnosis lists in rheumatology cases
links.effect: Correct diagnosis listed first in 65.6% of cases; differential diagnosis totally correct in 53.13% and totally complete in 62.50% of instances; no harmful or costly suggestions.
links.quote: ChatGPT was successful in 65.6% of the cases to suggest the correct diagnosis first in the list of differential diagnoses.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's diagnostic and management accuracy and safety on 32 simulated/retrospective rheumatology clinical cases without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
